Hi Ava / Marta —

Great talking yesterday. As promised, looping in our CS and delivery leads to formalize the mutual action plan and a lightweight implementation timeline so we can lock the kickoff and remove blockers before go-live. Attached is an initial "accordion" MAP that collapses into sprint-sized milestones — the idea is to keep a single source we can expand/contract depending on stakeholder audience.

High-level asks from Capella for planning:
- Confirm kickoff week (we proposed week of Sep 7)
- Identify an SSO/IdP owner and an Ops contact for pre-kick tech readout (we noted eng-ops@capellahealth.com)
- Any compliance evidence windows (SOC2 / retention) that require pre-provisioning

Proposed top milestones (high level):
1) Pre-kick tech readout (Aug 31) — validate network, SSO, and storage retention rules — owner: Capella Eng Ops
2) Kickoff & alignment (Sep 8) — owners: Tessa (acct) + Marissa (CS)
3) Integration sprint 1 — ingest + routing (2 weeks) — owner: Marissa
4) Load & perf validation (1 week) — owner: Ben
5) Cutover & monitoring runbook handoff (go-live target Sep 28) — owners: CS + SRE

I've attached Capella_Accordion_MAP_v0.1.xlsx with the expanded milestone grid and a short-risk column. Please review and confirm the kickoff week and point people. If Sep 7 is tight, suggest we shift to Sep 14 but aim to keep the same cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Best,

Thanks Tessa and Ava. Per Tessa's MAP and Ava's asks, here's an owner-level implementation grid and risk register summary to share with Capella this week. Attaching a compact checklist for handoff items.

- Pre-kick tech readout (Capella Eng Ops / Aug 31) — deliverable: network diagram + IdP metadata
- Kickoff & scoping (Marissa / Sep 8) — deliverable: final MAP, acceptance criteria, communication cadence
- Integration Sprint 1 — data ingestion & routing (Marissa / Sep 9-22) — deliverable: ingestion verification report
- SSO integration & account mapping (Karthik / Sep 9-15) — deliverable: SAML assertion tests + user mapping doc
- Load & perf validation (Ben / Sep 23-27) — deliverable: perf report, token-cost forecast
- Cutover rehearsal & runbook finalization (SoojIN / Sep 25-27) — deliverable: runbook + rollback steps

- Performance baseline for typical payloads — Ben to run a focused quantized run on Sep 20 if we get sample payloads by Sep 10

I've attached implementation_checklist.pdf for the pre-kick checklist and evidence items Capella will want to see. I'll push the MAP into the shared doc and give Capella reviewer access once SSO owner is confirmed.

Ava / team —

Adding a bit more detail on the load/perf and cutover windows so you have expectations ahead of the perf sprint. Summary: we propose two short non-production rehearsals and one production dry-run during the go-live window.

Planned perf activities:
- Non-prod rehearsal 1 (Sep 17): smoke tests, basic throughput validation (30m)
- Non-prod rehearsal 2 (Sep 20): full-load tests using 75% of projected peak (90m)
- Production dry-run (Sep 28 morning): controlled small traffic ramp to validate KV cache and monitoring alarms (60m)

Acceptance criteria:
- 95th pct latency < 450ms for the sample prompt set under expected concurrency
- No authentication errors in SSO flow during rehearsals
- Alerting and runbook actions validated by SRE

If Capella can share a short sample payload set by Sep 10, I'll run a quick quantized model pass to estimate token cost and perf. Attached is a short load-test-plan.md with run steps and monitoring checks.

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
